Teaching: `Type[Args]` → `Type<Args>` (S33)

What

Teaching: `Type[Args]` → `Type<Args>` (S33)

Why

The registered parse rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0034

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0034: tests/ui/generic_square_brackets.stderr.

Error [E0034]: `Shared[...]` isn't how Jet writes generic types
  --> tests/ui/generic_square_brackets.jet:1:24
    |
  1 | fn accept(value: Shared[Int]) {
    |                        ^
 Why: square brackets start collection types like `[Int]` or `[String:Int]`, and collection values like `[1, 2]`
 Fix: write angle brackets for generic arguments, or use `[Int]` for a list type
